title: TCP to HTTPS, one request under a microscope
intro: Trace a mobile request from opening the connection to authenticating the server, counting the first byte and understanding what packet loss changes.
how: Follow the mechanism, predict a change and check your answer. Optional depth is available from the same puzzle.

assumes.title: Mobile system design, from a packet to an app

modules.title: Module 1: Open, secure and reuse a connection
modules.blurb: Follow sequence numbers, missing bytes, TLS proof and a first-byte budget.

modules.title: Module 2: Share a connection under loss
modules.blurb: Compare delivery on HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 with the same two requests.
